notes: In Andrew's Amazon cart, qty 1, read 2026-11-17 ("I got 2 in my amazon cart, review and find better one"): his pick under review, not a decision. Andrew, 2026-11-17: "I want a floating kitchen island. Place on the wall opposite side of wall of where the living room console is (in the kitchen is where I will put it)." Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-20); taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. The kitchen is not measured, so the walkway in front of the piece (F-30: 30" at least, 36" preferred; 42" where it faces the range, sink or fridge, the designer's standard) is unchecked until Andrew tapes from that wall to whatever faces it. Fit: 41.7" plus its towel bar leaves under 9.3" of the 51"; 17.7" deep with the leaf down, 29.5" with it up; 34.7" tall, 1.3" under a 36" counter. The leaf hangs on the back, so against the wall it cannot be raised: the cart has to roll out first. One drawer, two doors, a side spice rack, a towel bar, five casters, two that lock. Materials: the rows say Wood and a bullet says solid wood, but a buyer describes "plastic laminate covering the composite 'wood' material" that cracked where holes were not drilled through; one 1-star review: the leaf "broke off 3 weeks after"; a 4-star: "a solid 7 hours to assemble"; Amazon's summary: mixed assembly, some wheel locks failing. 4.2 stars (191); Amazon's Choice; 600+ bought in past month; ships from and sold by S-PLUS; returnable until Jan 31, 2027; Prime, FREE delivery Tomorrow, November 18; Black is $184.99. Review, 2026-11-17: the weaker of his two: the thinnest record, a leaf he cannot use where it will stand, and a laminate top. Flags: none from the vocabulary; the walkway is unchecked. rooms: the brief.
